sources.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4
sources.evidence: October 6, 2026 launch explicitly offers the public-preview API that day and plans weights for month end. Reports approximately 1T total and 52B active parameters, multimodal understanding, coding, agentic work, and hybrid instruction/reasoning MoE.

sources.title: Mistral Large 4 official model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact v26.10 card identifies granular Mixture-of-Experts, 1.05T total, 52B active and a 1.6B vision encoder; release October 6, 2026; context advertised as 1M; function calling. HTML weights table marks artifact and license Coming soon, with no exact integer context.

sources.title: Mistral Large 4 official model documentation, Markdown
sources.evidence: Successfully fetched Markdown explicitly bridges API names mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0, confirms Public Preview v26.10, text/image input and reasoning/text output, 1M context, and links the exact planned Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B artifact as Coming soon.

sources.title: Official Mistral Large 4 upcoming-release page
sources.evidence: The exact artifact linked by Mistral docs is an upcoming release with October 31, 2026 ETA. It explicitly distinguishes 49B active per token from 52B including embeddings and output layers, reconciling the otherwise conflicting active counts. This is a preview landing page, not released weights or an accessible configuration.

sources.title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
sources.evidence: October 21, 2026 article describes the same Mistral Large 4 preview as approximately 1T total with 49B active and weights planned for late October. Its shorter active-count convention is resolved by the exact official upcoming-release page.

sources.title: Mistral reasoning documentation
sources.evidence: Explicitly lists mistral-large-4-0 as supporting reasoning_effort. High returns a thinking chunk before the final answer; none omits the thinking chunk. This establishes dedicated adjustable reasoning, not merely generic reasoning performance.

sources.title: Mistral changelog, October 6 release
sources.evidence: October 6 entry announces mistral-large-4 public preview and says its weights are coming soon; describes multimodal MoE and 1M context.

sources.title: Official current model comparison table, Markdown
sources.evidence: Exact Mistral Large 4 row lists mistral-large-4, text/image input, reasoning/text output and 1M context, with an empty license cell. The adjacent Large 3 Apache 2.0 entry does not license Large 4.

sources.title: Models.dev exact Mistral Large 4 record
sources.evidence: Catalog lead reports 1048576 context, open_weights=false and October 6 release. Primary sources independently verify identity and release. Its exact context is independently matched by OpenRouter Mistral default-route metadata, while developer documentation itself only advertises 1M.

sources.title: Exact planned artifact metadata access attempt
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated metadata request returned HTTP 401. No configuration or tensor metadata was obtained, and no access gate was bypassed. Weight availability is determined from the public upcoming-release page rather than this error.

sources.title: OpenRouter live endpoint metadata for exact Mistral Large 4 canonical release
sources.evidence: Exact API data identifies Mistral as provider and reports context_length 1048576 for default mistral and mistral/zdr routes, but 524288 for mistral/eu. All three list max_completion_tokens 262144. These are documented hosted-route limits, not a native checkpoint configuration or a live inference boundary test.

name.note: Exact October 2026 preview identity; official Markdown bridges mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0. Le Chonk is its nickname, not a separate variant.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the release and linked artifact; Mistral is the normalized catalog developer.

family.note: The exact model is named Mistral Large 4 and its API identifier belongs to the Mistral Large series. No Large 3 specifications are transferred.

release_date.note: Earliest documented public API preview, explicitly available on the dated launch day. October 31 is the planned weight-release ETA, not this API release date.

open_weights.note: As of review the exact artifact is Upcoming release and official docs say Coming soon. Open in marketing describes the announced release plan; it does not establish already downloadable weights.

license.note: The exact weights license is Coming soon in the official table and absent from the comparison row. No named weight license or supported model-specific proprietary classification is established. API terms are separate; Large 3 Apache 2.0 is not transferable.

parameters_b.note: Developer-disclosed nominal total: 1.05T = 1050B. The launch rounds to 1T. The card separately mentions a 1.6B vision encoder without explicitly clarifying inclusion; retain the labeled total and do not add 1.6B or claim a complete tensor count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal inclusive active count. Official upcoming-release page explicitly reconciles 49B active per token with 52B including embeddings/output layers. The October 21 article uses 49B without the convention; retain that distinction rather than treating it as a model revision.

architecture.note: Exact official card specifies granular Mixture-of-Experts. Layer counts, expert routing details and attention implementation remain undisclosed in accessed sources; no Large 3 architecture details are inherited.

context_window.note: Documented hosted capacity, independently verified in OpenRouter exact-release metadata for the Mistral default and ZDR routes. The Mistral EU route instead lists 524288. Developer docs advertise nominal 1M; this is not an independently established native checkpoint bound or tested direct-API enforcement limit.

modalities.note: Explicit official input/output list. Reasoning is a textual output stream represented separately by the reasoning capability, not an additional media modality.

reasoning.note: Exact versioned API supports high/none reasoning_effort and thinking chunks; official model documentation bridges this identifier to the audited alias.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly listed for the exact model on chat completions and conversations endpoints.

patch.notes: Public API preview released 2026-10-06; weights remain an upcoming release with an October 31 ETA at review. Nominal total is 1.05T. Active 52B includes embeddings/output layers; the official upcoming-release page calls the other convention 49B per token. The 1.6B vision encoder is separately disclosed, but total inclusion is not explicit. Developer context is advertised as 1M; 1048576 is independently documented for OpenRouter Mistral default/ZDR routes, while its EU route reports 524288. Native checkpoint context was not obtained. Weight license is not yet named.

summary: Verified exact Mistral Large 4 public-preview identity and October 6 release. Filled 1050B nominal total, 52B inclusive active and MoE architecture from primary documentation; exact official upcoming-release page resolves 49B/52B conventions. Confirmed text/image input, text output, adjustable reasoning and function calling. Weights are forthcoming and their license undisclosed. Independently confirmed 1048576 as hosted Mistral default/ZDR route capacity via OpenRouter, preserving the 524288 EU-route difference and distinguishing both from the unverified native checkpoint boundary. No configuration, weight tensors or sibling architecture details were inferred.
